hypothesis: When the tests skill runs all the checks once with the verbose flag, in place of one run for each requirement and then a run of all, the red step takes one turn in place of two, and the main session of the tests stage costs less.
lever: fewer turns (one verbose run in place of several runs)

edits.find:
Run the checks of each requirement through the checks port. Use a time limit of a few
minutes for each run. A run that does not finish is a broken check, not a red one. Send
that check back to the test writer before you lock.
edits.replace:
Run all the checks once, through the checks port, with the verbose flag of the runner.
Use a time limit of a few minutes. The name of each check carries its requirement ID, so
one run shows the result of each requirement. Do not run the checks again for each
requirement. A run that does not finish is a broken check, not a red one. Send that check
back to the test writer before you lock.
